an2.1:3.3: they whip, cane, and club him; they cut off hands or feet or both, ears or noses or both; they make him a porridge pot, a shell-shave, Rāhu’s mouth, a garland of fire, a burning hand, a bulrush twist, a bark dress, an antelope, a meat hook, coins, a caustic pickle, a twisting bar, a straw mat; they splash him with hot oil, feed him to the hounds, impale him alive on stakes, and behead him with a sword.
an2.1:3.5: they would beat him with whips … and behead him with a sword.’
